confidence: Limited calibration and 8 completed batches. Repeated samples, shared sources and semantic families are correlated; no general or internal causal weakness is established.
abstract_search_hypotheses: A natural complete-set question may reveal omission, extra selection or loss of entity/plan/completion scope between supported facts and the final answer.
A source-defined sequence or prerequisite relation set may reveal reversed/invented relations, omitted indirect prerequisites, or disagreement between the visible reasoning and final answer.
batch_review_assessment: Visible examples include unsupported extras, complete-set omissions, ordering reversals and partial-relation direction errors; these are separate observed output patterns, not one inferred mechanism.

Correct and fully strict-valid tasks provide counterexamples. Keep state/speaker bindings and queried relation domains explicit while discovering natural needs; do not assume every local task exposes a weakness.

Strict format validity or a correct final box does not establish every item judgment/reason/citation is semantically aligned. Feedback remains abstract and does not alter frozen scoring or first answers.
alternative_explanations: Displayed-item mapping, speaker/action-state attribution, multi-step sequence reconstruction, query-domain tracking, wording and ordinary source ambiguity.
Some tasks are locally easy or context-free; language and author/root/structure are mixed and samples correlated.
applicability: Discover real relations and a natural information need in the complete assigned source. Require individually decidable claims or a uniquely defined relation set.
do_not_force: No fixed Gold count, question-type ratio or complexity threshold.
Do not copy prior tasks or build artificial bundles to match a hypothesis.
Do not assume all local sets or sequences of these kinds are difficult.
exploration_direction: Explore naturally supported multi-select, complete ordering and partial ordering. A local or easy task may be sound, and a root may yield zero safe new questions.
